notes.subject: סירים
notes.rationale: Tok i gat tupela mining: ol pen (ol i gro hastu) o ol pot; Targum i tok 'ol bikman' — mi holim 'ol pen' long literal.

notes.subject: סבכים / סבואים
notes.rationale: Tu tok i sanap klostu: s-v-k (piksap) na s-v-a (dring) — saun i wankain, pasin bilong ol man i dring i piksap olgeta; Tok Pisin i no ken holim dispela pun.

notes.subject: סבא
notes.rationale: Lemma 'sava' (man i dring tumas) i kamap long Tanakh hia tasol.

notes.subject: ves 10
notes.rationale: Fes hap i duskis — ol tok i piksap wantaim, man i no save klin long wonem i bin tok; picture i stap antap long klia mining.

translation: Long wanem, taim ol i piksap wantaim olsem ol pen, na wantaim dring bilong ol ol i dring i draipela — ol bai kaiap olgeta olsem ol drai gras, drai pulap.
